description: Request an instant total quote for a physical task in Japan: shopping proxy (including limited-edition and in-store-only items), in-store stock checks, on-site photo capture, restaurant phone reservations in Japanese, queueing / standing in line, or package forwarding. The total is itemised (item price + quote fee JPY 2,200 + handling fee + shipping). Requesting a quote is free: the quote fee (JPY 2,200) is charged as part of the total when you accept, and is non-refundable once charged. Getting a quote does not reserve execution: accepting a quote only places the request in pending_review. The response includes an access_token shown only once: store it, it authorises accept/decline/status/evidence/messages for this quote.

currency.description: USD totals use the FX rate fixed at quote time.

details.description: Service-specific details: store name/address, target items, photo subjects, restaurant name + party size + desired time (phone_reservation; venue_type must be 'restaurant'), queue location, package sender/destination, etc.

item_price_jpy.description: Alternative to items[]: total item price, tax incl., JPY.

requester.description: Who is asking: agent name and a contact the operator can reply to.

shipping_jpy.description: Optional shipping override in JPY; defaults apply otherwise.

test_mode.description: If true, this is a test order: the flow is simulated and no payment is requested.

name: migawari__request_quote
title: Request a quote
